parameters.content:
## recv-thehive-event (C4, N8N-1.5; C11 writer, N8N-2.9)
**Trigger:** `POST /webhook/thehive-event` from TheHive's webhook (every event of the SOC organisation), token as `Authorization: Bearer` (C4).
**Inputs:** the TheHive audit event (`operation`, `objectType`, `objectId`, top-level `_createdBy` = the actor, top-level `_createdAt` = the event time, `details`, `object`).
**Actions taken:** records a summary of every event (operation, object type and id, actor, request id, source, sourceRef), then routes it (first match wins): (1) actor n8n@asox.local (lib-config): ignored, loop prevention; (2) delete: ignored (decided 2026-10-14, N8N-1.5); (3) alert update with caseId: promoted or merged; (4) alert update with status; (5) case create; (6) case update with status/stage (closing); (7) alert or case update with severity; (8) Task / Log / Comment: analyst activity (no-op stub, N8N-7.2); (9) anything else: recorded, no handler. **Next to the route** (C9 v0): an alert update whose tags newly include lib-config `response.approval.tag` (`approve:firewall-drop`; `details.tagChanges` added it, or without tagChanges `details.tags` has it), by anyone but n8n, calls **pb-ssh-response** (waited for, On Error = continue), which checks the approval and runs the response (interim approval for D-N5).
**C11 (routes 3-7):** updates the asox-metrics documents of the alerts concerned through lib-metrics-upsert (mode update: a missing document is skipped, never created), with the event's own time (`_createdAt`): status leaves New -> `t_ack`; Ignored / closed -> `resolution` (the status), `t_closed`; promoted, merged or case created from it -> `case_id`, `t_case`; case closed -> `resolution` (the case status) and `t_closed` on each of the case's alerts (read from TheHive); severity -> `severity`. First-time times are kept when already set. Never parks; the execution's `Event result` lists `<Wazuh alert id>: metrics: ok | skipped (<why>) | failed (<class>)`. Routes 3, 5 and 6 are also where N8N-5.3 attaches.
**Systems changed:** Wazuh indexer (asox-metrics documents); through pb-ssh-response, an agent's firewall (C9, live mode only) and TheHive.
**Approval:** not needed here: SOC bookkeeping only (asox-metrics documents); the response it hands on is pb-ssh-response's, which requires the analyst's approval tag.
**Owner:** n8n.
The C4 check's test alert is created by n8n's account, so its event ends at (1); the execution is still saved. Error workflow: recv-n8n-error.
Events caused by n8n's own account are ignored right after the summary, before lib-config (fast path, N8N-1.4); the execution is still saved.
